changelog.note: 190 (plan 189 A2e, DECISIONS 189): a customer's request for a price quote, from an email's own text, a request form (PDF) or a request list (Excel, CSV); G path only. The fields are the request's (customer, contact, deadline, reference, requested items), not those of any one trade: the price list and the quote belong to the quote's logic pack (A3, A4). Its own verification call site asks no invoice question; each requested item list is asked about missing and extra rows.
